title: Cow in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#f5f2ea'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='58' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e2d4'/>
  <rect x='44' y='80' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8e2d4'/>
  <rect x='58' y='80' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8e2d4'/>
  <rect x='70' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e2d4'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='89' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2f5c'/>
  <rect x='44' y='89' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2f5c'/>
  <rect x='58' y='89' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2f5c'/>
  <rect x='70' y='89' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2f5c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='19' ry='15' fill='#f5f2ea'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='27' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='28' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8e2d4' transform='rotate(-25 30 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='28' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#e8e2d4' transform='rotate(25 70 28)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M38 20 Q34 12 39 9' stroke='#e6d8a8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 20 Q66 12 61 9' stroke='#e6d8a8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#2b2350'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#2b2350'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#f0b8c4'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='41' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#b56b7e'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='41' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#b56b7e'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M32 48 Q50 56 68 48 Q68 54 50 60 Q32 54 32 48 Z' fill='#e0453f'/>
  <path d='M58 54 Q62 66 56 72 Q52 68 54 56 Z' fill='#e0453f'/>
  <path d='M33 50 Q50 57 67 50' stroke='#f7a099' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- scarf fringe -->
  <path d='M56 71 L58 76 M54 70 L55 75' stroke='#f7a099' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M80 60 Q88 56 86 48' stroke='#e8e2d4' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='46' r='4' fill='#5b4a8a'/>
</svg>
